source.rights: 项目原创，AI辅助编写；模拟场景与数据
source.method: 从本次新原创阅读派生的规则、原句词与不同情境输出；不改名复用旧源。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: ______ the weather was bad, they decided to go hiking.
questions.explanation: 句子表达让步关系“虽然天气不好，他们还是决定去徒步”，因此用 Although。
questions.evidence: Although the policy was popular with parents, the school saw a 20 percent drop in students buying drinks at lunch.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: You will fail the exam ______ you study harder.
questions.explanation: unless 表示“除非”，句意为“除非你更努力学习，否则考试会不及格”。
questions.evidence: If people understand the reason for a rule, they are more likely to follow it willingly rather than find ways around it.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: She was tired, ______ she finished the report.
questions.explanation: 前后句为转折关系“她很累，但还是完成了报告”，用 but 连接。
questions.evidence: The council had achieved its environmental target, but at the cost of damaging the local economy.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: ______ the rain, the match continued.
questions.explanation: Despite 是介词，后接名词短语；Although 后接从句。这里 the rain 是名词短语，所以用 Despite。
questions.evidence: Despite the rain, the match continued.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: He studied hard, ______ he passed the test.
questions.explanation: 前后为因果关系“他努力学习，所以通过了考试”，用 so。
questions.evidence: The policy had reduced the school's official sales figures, but it had not changed students' actual consumption.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: ______ you finish your homework, you can watch TV.
questions.explanation: As long as 表示“只要”，引导条件状语从句。
questions.evidence: As long as you finish your homework, you can watch TV.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The company lost money ______ the new manager made poor decisions.
questions.explanation: 句子表达因果关系“公司亏损是因为新经理做了糟糕的决定”，用 because。
questions.evidence: In fact, the school nurse reported a slight increase in students feeling tired in the afternoon, possibly because they were replacing balanced meals with sugary snacks from outside.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: ______ it was raining, we went for a walk.
questions.explanation: Even though 表示“即使，尽管”，引导让步状语从句，语气比 although 更强。
questions.evidence: Even though it was raining, we went for a walk.

title: The Ripple Effect: When a Well-Meant Rule Backfires · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
在英语中，我们可以用不同的连接词来表达让步（虽然、尽管）、条件（如果、除非）和因果（因为、所以）。让步常用 although, though, even though, while 等；条件常用 if, unless, as long as 等；因果常用 because, since, as, so, therefore 等。复杂句可以包含一个主句和一个或多个从句，而简单句只包含一个主谓结构。写作时，交替使用复杂句和简单句可以使文章节奏更好、逻辑更清晰。例如：'Although the policy was popular, it had unintended effects.'（让步）'If people understand the reason, they are more likely to follow.'（条件）'The council achieved its target, but it damaged the economy.'（转折/因果）。注意：although 和 but 不能同时用在同一个句子中；because 和 so 也不能同时使用。

Although the policy was popular with parents, the school saw a 20 percent drop in students buying drinks at lunch.
